marc:datafield.marc:subfield: "Birdie Buddy" tells the story of former pro golfer John Lee (Lee Yong-woo) and how he leads two young girls to become the next golf queens. John Lee became the first Korean to win a PGA title. His background was a mystery and he was an adoptee. However, although he successfully won PGA but John Lee stopped playing golf and become a golf course tester. Min Hae-ryung (Lee Da-hee) was raised to become an elite golf player and was always surrounded in the best environment to play golf. Her emotions have always been controlled and she has a deep wound inside of her. Soong Mi-soo (UEE) is a country girl from Kangwondo. She comes from a poor background, but her mom worked as caddie.
